liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (5 reviews): Baby Blue as an encore had not been played since 02/24/74, according to the reviewer; Reviewer calls Baby Blue unforgettable and believes it was the first time played since the sixties [8][9][10][14][17]
- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Garcia settled into the groove and lifted the crowd; the review stresses the song's dynamics; Sugaree is full of ornamental Garcia guitar fills [6][7]
- **On The Road Again** (1 review): Reviewer loved the travel-themed songs, On the Road Again among them [10]
- **Peggy O** (1 review): The reviewer found Peggy-O very nice [6]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Ship of Fools singled out as the second-set highlight apart from the encore [14]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Playin' into China Cat Sunflower is played at a notably fast tempo [11]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): I Need a Miracle into Goin' Down the Road was a second-set highlight [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-08-14.152263.fob.nak700.blend.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 171 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1981-08-14.aud.severson.91768.flac1644**: audience recording; 27 songs; 168 min; rated 3.14/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd81-08-14.nak700.gardner.8213.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 161 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording leans heavy on bass, which the reviewer says is how the Seattle Center sounds; Sounds somewhat distant at first, then improves in the second set as the taper seems to have adjusted and moved closer; Sound gets better as the tape goes on, though it remains an audience recording [6][7][8]
- **gd1981-08-14.152262.fob.nak700.blend.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 26 songs; 171 min [3]

## Around the show

- Recalled as a beautiful summer day at the Seattle fairgrounds, with fans arriving from across the country after a Utah show two days earlier [9]
- Reviewer's first West Coast show, after hitchhiking across the USA; the energy was very high [10]
- Reviewer suggests pairing this show with the Portland show the following night [7]
- Reviewer ranks the long, creative first set with those of 9/12, 12/5 and 12/30 as 1981's best [14]
- Reviewer sees 1981 as the Brent-era peak, with older songs like On The Road Again returning to rotation [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-08-14.152263.fob.nak700.blend.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes (45' from stage, center); (2) Nakamichi 700 cardioid mics (L/R) + (1) Nakamichi 700 omni (center) blend,… [1]. Also: Brian Schley's unidentified audience source fills a 0:16 patch in the I Know You Rider jam; Pitch correction was done with help from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1981-08-14.aud.severson.91768.flac1644**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by David Minches; source: 3 Nak 700s with 2 carcoid, center omni head> Sony TC-D5 (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs) [2]. Also: A crossfade at 0:17 covers a tape flip [2]
- **gd81-08-14.nak700.gardner.8213.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 700's [4]. Also: Recorded with NAK 700 microphones into a Sony TC-D5M, then cassette master to DAT to CDR [4]
- **gd1981-08-14.152262.fob.nak700.blend.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes (45' from stage, center); (2) Nakamichi 700 cardioid mics (L/R) + (1) Nakamichi 700 omni (center) blend,… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1981-08-14 Fri Seattle Center Memorial Coliseum, Seattle, WA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1291501218937/grateful-dead-1981-08-14-fri-seattle) [19]
